# Dane Anderson Window Cleaning
> Residential and commercial window cleaning serving Santa Cruz to Monterey, California.

Dane Anderson Window Cleaning provides residential and commercial window cleaning, screen cleaning and repair, hard water stain removal, and gutter cleaning across the Santa Cruz to Monterey coastal corridor in California. The business serves homeowners, property managers, and business owners, and is fully insured for both residential and commercial work.

## Services
- **Residential Window Cleaning**: Interior and exterior window, track, and screen cleaning for homes of every size.
- **Commercial Window Cleaning**: Storefront, office, and multi-tenant building glass on recurring schedules.
- **Screen Cleaning & Repair**: Screen washing, re-screening, and frame repair for salt-corroded mesh.
- **Hard Water Stain Removal**: Mineral deposit and sprinkler overspray removal that restores glass clarity.
- **Gutter Cleaning**: Debris removal and downspout flushing ahead of the rainy season.

## Service Areas
- Santa Cruz, CA (primary market)
- Capitola, CA
- Aptos, CA
- Watsonville, CA
- Monterey, CA
- Pacific Grove, CA
- Carmel-by-the-Sea, CA

## Business Information
- **Service Area**: Santa Cruz to Monterey, CA (mobile service, no fixed storefront address)
- **Phone**: (831) 224-3387
- **Website**: https://daneandersonwindowcleaning.com

## Key Differentiators
- Purified, deionized water-fed cleaning process built for salt air and hard water conditions specific to this coastline
- Fully insured for residential and commercial ladder and upper-story access
- Locally owned and operated along the full Santa Cruz to Monterey corridor
